build_HierarchicalPolicy_from_config: build a HierarchicalPolicy instance from a Habitat config with defined skills and PDDL domain
run_HierarchicalPolicy_act: run the HierarchicalPolicy act method to get actions by coordinating high-level and low-level skill policies
review_HierarchicalPolicy_update_skills: review the HierarchicalPolicy _update_skills method that selects new skills based on the high-level policy decisions
review_HierarchicalPolicy_get_terminatio: review the HierarchicalPolicy _get_terminations method that decides when the high-level or low-level policy wants to terminate a skill
summarize_HierarchicalPolicy_broadcast_s: summarize the HierarchicalPolicy _broadcast_skill_ids method that groups batch observations and data per skill for efficient processing
